rule: Rewards are always earned in full. The register asks once per trip: use today's rewards now at 80%, or save them in full on the account. Saving is the default; one choice covers the whole trip (no splitting); it is logged. 80% is rounded to the cent in the member's favor. Not asked when Thrift+ credit covers the total (B3).
title: Use today or save
words: Use today: $28 off. Or save $35 for 30 days.
